roadmap.title: Core progression
roadmap.description: Advance the opening story while upgrading gear, Martial Arts, Internal Arts, and the two Ability Steal weapons.

roadmap.title: Qinghe completion
roadmap.description: Finish Qinghe campaigns and encounters, collect regional targets, defeat the timed boss, and complete the Qinghe Tales and Echoes route.

roadmap.title: Kaifeng completion
roadmap.description: Clear Kaifeng campaigns, bosses, encounters, exploration targets, and the Ever-Normal Granary follow-up.

roadmap.title: Hexi completion
roadmap.description: Clear the Hexi story and Jianghu Legacy routes, regional exploration tasks, timed boss, and Goosy Slide campaign-boss cleanup.

roadmap.title: Imperial Palace completion
roadmap.description: Finish the palace campaigns and side activities, activate every Boundary Stone, and beat The Lone Tyrant within the limit.

roadmap.title: Hidden Mountain completion
roadmap.description: Finish the new Hidden Mountain campaigns, tales, exploration interactions, and mask entry condition; use the in-game tracker for entries still awaiting complete community routes.

roadmap.title: Final base-set cleanup
roadmap.description: Verify that every original Qinghe and Kaifeng Steam achievement has unlocked to trigger the base meta-achievement.

achievements.displayName: The Hero is the Voice of the World
achievements.description: All achievements unlocked. With heroic compassion, we've journeyed thousands of miles together.
achievements.summary: Unlock every Steam achievement in the original @mechanic{Qinghe and Kaifeng achievement set}.

guide.context: The base meta-achievement excludes Hexi and later regional additions, so it can register before all 61 current Steam entries are complete.

steps.text: Complete every original Steam achievement assigned to @loc{Qinghe}.
Complete every original Steam achievement assigned to @loc{Kaifeng} and the shared progression group.
Return to normal play after the last required base-set unlock so Steam awards the meta-achievement.

achievements.description: Defeat the Demon Goose once.
achievements.summary: Fail the Demon Goose treatment near @loc{West Heavens Pier}, then defeat the hostile @enemy{Demon Goose}.

guide.context: The treatment minigame is the trigger for combat; repeatedly pressing the wrong prompt fails it, and Tai Chi can end the difficult fight by throwing the goose into the river.

steps.text: Near @loc{West Heavens Pier}, activate Wind Sense and approach the @enemy{Demon Goose}.
Start the treatment minigame and deliberately fail it so the Demon Goose attacks.
Defeat the Demon Goose with normal attacks or use @mechanic{Tai Chi} to throw it into the river.

achievements.description: Defeat ​The Void King within 60s.
achievements.summary: After completing @mechanic{Gleaming Abyss}, defeat the @enemy{Void King} within @mechanic{60 seconds}.

guide.context: The campaign unlocks the replayable boss fight, and lowering the difficulty plus improving gear makes the one-minute requirement substantially safer.

steps.text: Complete the @mechanic{Gleaming Abyss} campaign to unlock the Void King fight.
Equip a high-damage build and select an easier difficulty if the first attempt exceeds one minute.
Start the fight and defeat the @enemy{Void King} within @mechanic{60 seconds}.

achievements.description: Defeat Wolf Maiden.
achievements.summary: Find and defeat the @enemy{Wolf Maiden} open-world boss in Kaifeng.

guide.context: The achievement is tied directly to the open-world boss kill and does not require a special finishing move.

steps.text: Locate the @enemy{Wolf Maiden} boss marker in Kaifeng and enter the arena.
Defeat the Wolf Maiden and remain through the encounter-completion result.

achievements.description: Defeat Zheng E within 180s.
achievements.summary: After @mechanic{Ever-Normal Granary}, defeat @enemy{Zheng E} within @mechanic{180 seconds}.

guide.context: Completing the campaign unlocks the boss fight; stronger gear and an easier difficulty help preserve the three-minute margin.

steps.text: Complete the @mechanic{Ever-Normal Granary} campaign to unlock Zheng E's fight.
Start the encounter with a high-damage build and defeat @enemy{Zheng E} within @mechanic{180 seconds}.

achievements.description: Clear Campaign: Palace of Annals.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{Palace of Annals} from Journal > Campaign and complete its entire Qinghe campaign.

guide.context: Palace of Annals is also one of the prerequisites for Halo Peak and the final Qinghe route, so clearing it early avoids later backtracking.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Journal > Campaign > Palace of Annals} and track the campaign.
Complete every tracked Palace of Annals objective through the campaign conclusion.

achievements.description: Clear Campaign: Still Shore.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{Still Shore} from Journal > Campaign and complete its entire Qinghe campaign.

guide.context: The campaign can also be discovered at its world entrance, but the Journal > Campaign listing provides the direct tracked route.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Journal > Campaign > Still Shore} and track the campaign.
Follow the tracked Still Shore objectives through the campaign's final completion screen.

achievements.description: Clear Campaign: Jinming Pool.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{Jinming Pool} from Journal > Campaign and complete its entire Kaifeng campaign.

guide.context: The Journal listing provides a direct route even if the campaign's physical world entrance has not been revisited.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Journal > Campaign > Jinming Pool} and track the campaign.
Complete every tracked Jinming Pool objective through the campaign conclusion.

achievements.description: Clear Campaign: Heavenfall.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{Heavenfall} from Journal > Campaign and complete its entire Kaifeng campaign.

guide.context: This achievement is awarded by campaign completion, so optional Kaifeng exploration is not part of its unlock condition.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Journal > Campaign > Heavenfall} and track the campaign.
Complete every tracked Heavenfall objective through the campaign conclusion.

achievements.description: Defeat the Nameless General.
achievements.summary: Find and defeat the @enemy{Nameless General} open-world boss in Kaifeng.

guide.context: This is an open-world boss rather than a campaign completion reward, so the achievement appears when the Nameless General's fight itself ends.

steps.text: Locate the @enemy{Nameless General} boss marker in Kaifeng and enter the arena.
Defeat the Nameless General and remain through the encounter-completion result.

achievements.description: Collect 250 Oddities in Kaifeng.
achievements.summary: Collect @mechanic{250 Oddities} throughout Kaifeng.

guide.context: Oddities are Kaifeng's peculiar open-world challenges, and their large total makes it efficient to clear each one encountered during quests and chest routes.

steps.text: Complete Kaifeng's Oddities and peculiar challenges until the regional counter reaches @mechanic{250}.

achievements.description: Complete 150 peculiar challenges in the Qinghe area.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{150 Oddities or peculiar challenges} across Qinghe.

guide.context: These small open-world activities are distributed throughout the region, so the efficient route is to clear them while traveling between quests and chests.

steps.text: Complete Qinghe's marked peculiar challenges and collected Oddities until the regional counter reaches @mechanic{150}.

achievements.description: Collect 40 chests.
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{40 treasure chests} within the Qinghe region.

guide.context: Qinghe contains far more than 40 chests, so opening visible chests during story, campaign, and exploration routes steadily advances the same regional total.

steps.text: Explore Qinghe and open every visible treasure chest until the regional count reaches @mechanic{40}.

achievements.description: Collect 40 chests in Kaifeng.
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{40 treasure chests} within the Kaifeng region.

guide.context: The counter is regional, and the many chests found during campaigns and exploration can be combined rather than collected from one sub-area.

steps.text: Explore Kaifeng and open every visible treasure chest until the regional count reaches @mechanic{40}.

achievements.description: Reach the highest point in Qinghe: Moonveil Mountain Tower.
achievements.summary: Climb to the highest point of @loc{Moonveil Mountain Tower} in Qinghe.

guide.context: The achievement checks reaching the top rather than completing a separate quest, so it can be collected whenever free exploration reaches the tower.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Moonveil Mountain Tower} in Qinghe and climb the structure to its highest reachable point.

achievements.description: Reach the highest point, East of Beast Reverie, in the Fair Grounds of Kaifeng.
achievements.summary: East of Beast Reverie in Kaifeng's @loc{Fair Grounds}, climb to the highest point of the tower.

guide.context: The unlock checks elevation at the landmark rather than campaign progress, so the tower can be climbed during ordinary free exploration.

steps.text: Travel to the @loc{Fair Grounds} in Kaifeng and move east of Beast Reverie.
Climb the area's tallest tower to its highest reachable point.

achievements.description: Solve 10 Meow Meow Puzzles in Qinghe.
achievements.summary: Clear @mechanic{10} of Qinghe's @mechanic{Meow Meow Puzzles}.

guide.context: Completed and available Meow Meow activities use cat-paw markers on the world map, making the regional count easier to route alongside chest cleanup.

steps.text: Use the Qinghe map's @mechanic{cat-paw icons} to locate and solve ten different Meow Meow Puzzles.

achievements.description: Solve 5 Meow Meow Puzzles in Kaifeng.
achievements.summary: Clear @mechanic{5} of Kaifeng's @mechanic{Meow Meow Puzzles}.

guide.context: Kaifeng cat puzzles use the same cat-paw map icon as Qinghe, but only five completions are required here.

steps.text: Use the Kaifeng map's @mechanic{cat-paw icons} to locate and solve five different Meow Meow Puzzles.

achievements.description: Transform into a rural dog once.
achievements.summary: At @loc{Blissful Retreat}, interact with the dogs to transform into a rural dog once.

guide.context: After the Qinghe main story removes the outdoor dogs, the nearby sword opens a Blissful Retreat dreamscape where the same transformation remains obtainable.

steps.text: Fast travel to @loc{Blissful Retreat} and check for the dogs outside the nearby house.
If the dogs are absent after the Qinghe story, interact with the nearby sword to enter the @mechanic{Blissful Retreat dreamscape}.
Approach the dogs in the normal area or dreamscape and use their interaction to transform into a rural dog.

achievements.description: Get defeated by Elder Gongsun in a Sparring match.
achievements.summary: Challenge @npc{Elder Gongsun} at Generals Shrine to Sparring and let him defeat the player character.

guide.context: A story encounter can award this naturally, but the Generals Shrine rematch provides a reliable cleanup opportunity.

steps.text: Fast travel to @loc{Generals Shrine} and speak with @npc{Elder Gongsun}.
Start a Sparring match and stop attacking until Elder Gongsun defeats the player character.

achievements.description: Reach Avg. Enhancement Lv.5.
achievements.summary: Raise the displayed @mechanic{average gear enhancement level} to 5 by enhancing every gear category evenly.

guide.context: The average is limited by under-upgraded categories, so concentrating materials in one weapon or armor slot will not efficiently increase this counter.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Develop > Gear > Enhance} and review the level shown for every gear category.
Upgrade the lowest categories first until the displayed average enhancement level reaches @mechanic{5}.

achievements.description: Equip 4 Internal Arts.
achievements.summary: Equip @mechanic{4 Internal Arts} simultaneously in Develop > Abilities > Inner Way.

guide.context: Selecting an empty Inner Way slot shows how its missing Internal Arts can be obtained, while ordinary progression awards more than the four required.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Develop > Abilities > Inner Way}.
Fill four Inner Way slots with four different @mechanic{Internal Arts} at the same time.

achievements.description: Tune an Epic gear to max level.
achievements.summary: Tune one equipped @item{Epic gear piece} to its maximum @mechanic{300/300} score and confirm the result.

guide.context: Gear consumed for tuning is permanently removed, so feed unused pieces rather than equipment reserved for another build.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Develop > Gear}, select an equipped Epic item, and choose @mechanic{Tune}.
Select enough unused gear to fill the tuning meter to @mechanic{300/300}.
Confirm the completed tune to apply the maximum score.

achievements.description: Enhance a piece of gear to Lv.2.
achievements.summary: Upgrade any @item{gear piece} from level 1 to @mechanic{level 2} in the Enhance menu.

guide.context: Gear enhancement is available under Develop > Gear, and this first upgrade requires only one item rather than an average across the loadout.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Develop > Gear > Enhance} and select any level 1 gear piece.
Spend the displayed materials to raise the selected gear piece to @mechanic{level 2}.

achievements.description: Upgrade a Martial Style to Lv. 30.
achievements.summary: Upgrade one @mechanic{Martial Style} to @mechanic{level 30} through Develop > Abilities > Martial Arts.

guide.context: Normal story and side-activity progress supplies the required materials; selecting a missing resource in the upgrade screen shows its available acquisition routes.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Develop > Abilities > Martial Arts > Upgrade} and select one Martial Style.
Spend the listed resources until the selected Martial Style reaches @mechanic{level 30}.

achievements.description: Master the Panacea Fan.
achievements.summary: In eastern Qinghe, find the cave east of the large river bend, interact with the statue outside its entrance, and complete the @mechanic{Panacea Fan Ability Steal}.

guide.context: The mastery activity remains available even if another route has already unlocked the Panacea Fan, so owning the weapon does not block the achievement.

steps.text: In eastern Qinghe, travel east of the large river bend to the cave shown on the regional map.
Outside the cave door, interact with the small stone statue, then complete the full Ability Steal sequence for the @item{Panacea Fan}.

achievements.description: Master the Strategic Sword.
achievements.summary: At the southeastern coastal cave beside a small inland pool, activate the statue and complete the @mechanic{Strategic Sword Ability Steal}.

guide.context: This unlock comes from the dedicated Ability Steal activity rather than ordinary Strategic Sword combat or weapon upgrading.

steps.text: Travel to the southeastern coast and find the cave beside the small inland pool shown on the regional map.
Interact with the small stone statue outside the cave, then finish the Ability Steal sequence to master the @item{Strategic Sword}.

achievements.description: Unlock the ending of main story of Qinghe.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{100% Qinghe Tales and Echoes}, complete @mechanic{The Promised Light}, and open the final story door.

guide.context: Full Qinghe journal completion requires every Bright Tide node, the Halo Peak campaign, and all seven Dark Surge stories before the unknown ending becomes available.

steps.text: Complete all Qinghe main-story quests so every @mechanic{Bright Tide} node is unlocked.
Unlock all @mechanic{7 Qinghe Dark Surge stories} and complete Halo Peak.
Finish @mechanic{Final: The Promised Light} and confirm Qinghe Tales and Echoes shows 100%.
Travel to the final indicated door and open it to trigger the unknown Qinghe ending.

achievements.description: Clear Campaign: Halo Peak.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{The Promised Light} after clearing Palace of Annals and Bodhi Sea and reaching @mechanic{6,000 Qinghe exploration points}.

guide.context: Exploration points come from side quests, Boundary Stones, Meow Meow Puzzles, and other Qinghe open-world activities.

steps.text: Clear both required campaigns: @mechanic{Palace of Annals} and @mechanic{Bodhi Sea}.
Raise Qinghe exploration to @mechanic{6,000 points} through regional activities.
In the Jianghu Legacy journal, select @mechanic{Final: The Promised Light} and finish that questline.

achievements.description: Unlock a Dark Surge story.
achievements.summary: Collect every fragment for any one @mechanic{Dark Surge story} and unlock that story in Journal > Tales and Echoes.

guide.context: Fragments come from specific side quests, NPC conversations, collectibles, and other regional activities; the journal records each incomplete story separately.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Journal > Tales and Echoes > Dark Surge} and select one incomplete Dark Surge story.
Complete the listed regional activities until every fragment for that Dark Surge story is collected.
Return to the Dark Surge journal and unlock the completed story.

achievements.description: Complete the final Kaifeng main-story quest.
achievements.summary: Complete the final @mechanic{Kaifeng main-story quest}.

guide.context: The hidden achievement is tied to the conclusion of Kaifeng's main route rather than a separate optional interaction.

steps.text: Continue the Kaifeng main story through its final quest and complete the concluding objective.

achievements.description: Complete 3 encounters in Qinghe.
achievements.summary: Accept and complete any @mechanic{3 Encounter quests} in Qinghe.

guide.context: An unaccepted Encounter appears as a question-mark icon and can disappear after a short time; accepting it preserves the quest in the Encounter menu.

steps.text: Explore Qinghe until a question-mark @mechanic{Encounter} icon appears, then accept the quest before the icon vanishes.
Complete the accepted Encounter and use @mechanic{Quest > Encounter > Encounter Journal} to find more hints.
Finish three different Qinghe Encounter quests.

achievements.description: Complete 3 encounters in Southeast Kaifeng.
achievements.summary: Accept and complete any @mechanic{3 Encounter quests} in Southeast Kaifeng.

guide.context: Unaccepted question-mark encounters can disappear; the Encounter Journal retains accepted quests and provides activation hints for undiscovered entries.

steps.text: Explore Southeast Kaifeng, accept a question-mark @mechanic{Encounter} before it disappears, and complete the quest.
Use @mechanic{Quest > Encounter > Encounter Journal} for activation hints and finish three Southeast Kaifeng Encounters.

achievements.description: Witness the full Granary of Plenty grain-relief story.
achievements.summary: After @mechanic{Ever-Normal Granary}, speak to Zheng E, leave the village note, then collect Zheng E's letter from his former house.

guide.context: Quest markers stop after the campaign, and Zheng E may require one or two in-game days to appear before the unmarked epilogue can begin.

steps.text: Complete the full @mechanic{Ever-Normal Granary} campaign.
Wait one or two in-game days if needed, then return to the campaign area and speak with @npc{Zheng E}.
Travel to the indicated village house and leave the requested note inside.
Return to Zheng E's former house and pick up the letter he left there.

achievements.description: Collect 20 chests of any quality in Hexi.
achievements.summary: Open @mechanic{20 treasure chests} of any quality within Hexi.

guide.context: Every chest quality contributes to the same regional total, so common chests found along the Hexi story route are sufficient.

steps.text: Explore Hexi and open treasure chests of any quality until the regional count reaches @mechanic{20}.

achievements.description: Solve 6 Meow Meow Puzzles in Hexi.
achievements.summary: Solve @mechanic{6 Meow Meow Puzzles} within Hexi.

guide.context: Hexi uses the same cat-paw activity markers as the earlier regions, allowing the six puzzles to be routed during chest cleanup.

steps.text: Use the Hexi map's @mechanic{cat-paw icons} to locate and solve six different Meow Meow Puzzles.

achievements.description: A fish atop the tallest tree? In this desert, anything goes.
achievements.summary: In @loc{Jade Gate Pass}, climb the large tree to its highest branch.

guide.context: This exploration unlock checks the top of the tree rather than a collectible or quest completion.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Jade Gate Pass}, locate the area's large tree, and climb to its highest reachable point.

achievements.description: Unlock the Cat Fever Encounter after completing its prerequisites.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Tale A Tassel} and @mechanic{The Final Retreat}, then pet the nearby cat @mechanic{5 times}.

guide.context: Each pet interaction has roughly a three-second cooldown, and merely unlocking the Cat Fever Encounter is sufficient; the Encounter itself does not need to be completed.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Tale A Tassel} by speaking with @npc{Granny Pan}, steal the requested item, and report to @npc{Young Yichao}.
Continue the linear Wandering Tale route and complete @mechanic{The Final Retreat}.
At the nearby cat, wait for the interaction cooldown and pet the cat five separate times until @mechanic{Cat Fever} appears.

achievements.description: Defeat Wucan within 180 seconds.
achievements.summary: Find @enemy{Wucan} in Liangzhou and defeat the boss within @mechanic{180 seconds}.

guide.context: The three-minute challenge is easier with upgraded gear and a lower difficulty, and the timer applies to the boss fight rather than travel to the arena.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Liangzhou}, locate the @enemy{Wucan} boss encounter, and prepare a high-damage build.
Start the encounter and defeat Wucan within @mechanic{180 seconds}.

achievements.description: Perform a 10x smash in Wang Quanyou's egg-smashing game.
achievements.summary: Buy @mechanic{10 hammers} from @npc{Wang Quanyou} in Liangzhou and perform one 10x egg smash.

guide.context: The achievement checks the bundled 10x action, so ten separate single smashes are not the same requirement.

steps.text: In @loc{Liangzhou}, speak with @npc{Wang Quanyou} at the egg-smashing game.
Spend the requested money on ten hammers and select the @mechanic{10x smash} option.

achievements.description: Complete Hexi Jianghu Legacy: The Homeward Vow.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{The Homeward Vow} from Hexi's Jianghu Legacy journal and complete the questline.

guide.context: The Jianghu Legacy becomes available after reaching Liangzhou, so no separate collectible threshold is required to begin it.

steps.text: After reaching @loc{Liangzhou}, open @mechanic{Journal > Jianghu Legacy} and track The Homeward Vow.
Complete every tracked objective through the conclusion of @mechanic{The Homeward Vow}.

achievements.description: Unlock all Tales and Echoes in Hexi.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{100% Hexi Tales and Echoes} by unlocking every Bright Tide and Dark Surge node.

guide.context: Bright Tide nodes come from the Hexi main story, while Dark Surge nodes require the region's separate fragment-based stories.

steps.text: Complete every Hexi main-story quest so all @mechanic{Bright Tide} nodes are unlocked.
Collect the required fragments and unlock every Hexi @mechanic{Dark Surge story}.
Open @mechanic{Journal > Tales and Echoes} and confirm Hexi displays 100%.

achievements.description: The tiny squeak of a woodchuck sealed your defeat.
achievements.summary: On @loc{Qinchuan Path}, approach the woodchuck guarding a treasure chest and let the @enemy{woodchuck} defeat the player character.

guide.context: The achievement requires losing to this specific small enemy, so killing it or only opening the nearby treasure does not satisfy the condition.

steps.text: Travel along @loc{Qinchuan Path} and locate the woodchuck sitting in front of a treasure chest.
Approach the @enemy{woodchuck}, avoid retaliating, and allow its attack to defeat the player character.

achievements.description: Clear Campaign - Dim Lamp Night.
achievements.summary: Progress @mechanic{Final: Gone with the Wind} and defeat @enemy{Azure Glow} during the Dim Lamp Night campaign.

guide.context: The final Jianghu Legacy entry appears only after enough Hexi story progress, so it may not be selectable on the first visit to Qinchuan Path.

steps.text: Advance Hexi's story until the Jianghu Legacy journal lists @mechanic{Final: Gone with the Wind}.
Track the questline and continue through @mechanic{Dim Lamp Night} until @enemy{Azure Glow} is defeated.

achievements.description: Defeat every required campaign boss using Goosy Slide.
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Goosy Slide} to defeat every required Campaign Challenge boss through @enemy{Guoxin}.

guide.context: Goosy Slide has a 25% instant-defeat chance on active bosses. Heartseeker, Qianye, God of Avarice, Liangzhou bosses, and later additions are outside the required through-Guoxin set.

steps.text: Equip the @mechanic{Goosy Slide} Mystic Skill.
Enter @mechanic{Wandering Paths}, open Challenges, choose Campaign Challenge, and select a required boss marked Resting.
Stand before the boss and use Goosy Slide for the instant defeat; if the boss is active, recast whenever available until the 25% effect triggers.
Apply the Goosy Slide defeat to every required campaign boss up to and including @enemy{Guoxin}.

achievements.description: Your martial prowess is the stuff of legend. Someone fetch the imperial robes. They were made for you.
achievements.summary: After completing @mechanic{Confinement Tower}, defeat @enemy{The Lone Tyrant} within @mechanic{180 seconds}.

guide.context: The campaign unlocks the boss fight, and the timer begins with combat rather than during the prerequisite campaign.

steps.text: Complete the @mechanic{Confinement Tower} campaign to unlock The Lone Tyrant encounter.
Use a high-damage build and defeat @enemy{The Lone Tyrant} within @mechanic{180 seconds}.

achievements.description: If the Emperor can wander these halls, so can you. Every last room of them.
achievements.summary: Discover and activate every @mechanic{Boundary Stone} in the Imperial Palace region.

guide.context: Boundary Stones function as the area's travel network, so activating each newly reached stone reduces later cleanup travel.

steps.text: Explore every Imperial Palace sub-area and activate each @mechanic{Boundary Stone} until none remain undiscovered.

achievements.description: Anyone can win by force, but true loyalty can't be beaten into someone. Earn it.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Palm of Health}, then finish @mechanic{5 Ultimate Slap events}.

guide.context: Ultimate Slap events do not become available until the Palm of Health side quest has been completed.

steps.text: Finish the side quest named @mechanic{Palm of Health}; its completion makes Ultimate Slap activities available.
Locate and successfully finish five separate @mechanic{Ultimate Slap events}.

achievements.description: Cross blades with the Black-Clad Thief under the moonlight.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Sealed Treasury} campaign and its moonlit fight against the @enemy{Black-Clad Thief}.

guide.context: The encounter is part of the campaign route, so starting Sealed Treasury from the Journal provides the required setup and time of day.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Journal > Campaign > Sealed Treasury} and track the campaign.
Complete every objective, including the moonlit battle with the @enemy{Black-Clad Thief}.

achievements.description: The palace holds more than silver and gold. Some things money simply can't buy.
achievements.summary: Follow the @mechanic{Art in Cricket} side quest and catch one @item{golden cricket}.

guide.context: The quest introduces the cricket-catching mechanic and awards the required golden specimen during its normal objective chain.

steps.text: Start and track the Imperial Palace side quest @mechanic{Art in Cricket}.
Follow the quest objectives and successfully catch the @item{golden cricket}.

achievements.description: Sit on the imperial throne.
achievements.summary: Enter the Imperial Palace throne room and use @mechanic{Sit} on the imperial throne.

guide.context: The unlock is attached to the throne interaction itself rather than completing a palace campaign.

steps.text: Travel to the @loc{Imperial Palace throne room}, approach the imperial throne, and select @mechanic{Sit}.

achievements.description: Some wounds are not carved in flesh, but in the soul itself.
achievements.summary: Complete the Hidden Mountain @mechanic{Changeless Heart} campaign involving the underwater-breathing bell.

guide.context: Reaching the underwater city does not end the route; the campaign must continue through the concluding Changeless Heart objective.

steps.text: Open Hidden Mountain's campaign journal and track @mechanic{Changeless Heart}.
Complete the campaign objectives through the underwater-breathing-bell city and its conclusion.

achievements.description: Every story needs an ending. You chose to make this one gentle.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Honor Among Thieves} on the coast west of @loc{Millennium Crossing}, then give the former prisoner his letter.

guide.context: Two completed encounters can make Honor Among Thieves appear: @mechanic{A Mound of Murmurs} and @mechanic{Tale Within Tale}. The prisoner may be standing on the ground or waiting in a nearby tree.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{A Mound of Murmurs}. Also finish @mechanic{Tale Within Tale}.
Travel to the coast directly west of @loc{Millennium Crossing} and speak with the prisoner to start @mechanic{Honor Among Thieves}; if he is in the tree, jump up until the talk interaction appears.
Complete every tracked Honor Among Thieves objective through the encounter's conclusion.
After the encounter ends, speak with the former prisoner and give him his letter.

achievements.description: Just one little boop. What could go wrong?
achievements.summary: During the @mechanic{Wooden Chicken} material objective, find and pet the @npc{baby boar} in the ground hollow.

guide.context: Several adult boars surround the correct hollow; the required interaction is with the smaller baby boar inside it.

steps.text: Progress the Hidden Mountain mission until the objective says to collect materials for the @item{Wooden Chicken}.
Within the Wooden Chicken objective area, find the small ground hollow surrounded by adult boars and approach the @npc{baby boar} inside.
Use the pet interaction on the baby boar.

achievements.description: I ask every mountain here: which of you dares stand taller?
achievements.summary: Climb the large rock pillar directly west of @loc{Gaping Chasm Boundary Stone} and approach the @mechanic{6 summit chests}.

guide.context: The tightly grouped six chests identify the correct summit, distinguishing this rock pillar from the other climbable peaks west of Gaping Chasm.

steps.text: Fast travel to @loc{Gaping Chasm Boundary Stone} and face directly west.
Reach and climb the large rock pillar to its summit.
Approach the cluster of @mechanic{six treasure chests} at the top.

achievements.description: Complete Hidden Mountain Campaign - Skyward City Ruins
achievements.summary: Complete the Hidden Mountain campaign @mechanic{Skyward City Ruins}.

guide.context: This achievement is tied to the campaign conclusion rather than the separate Hidden Mountain exploration interactions.

steps.text: Open Hidden Mountain's campaign journal and track @mechanic{Skyward City Ruins}.
Complete every tracked Skyward City Ruins objective through the campaign conclusion.

achievements.description: Never fly a bird while drunk, unless you're in a dream.
achievements.summary: In a Hidden Mountain dream, make the player character drunk and complete the @mechanic{bird-flight sequence}.

guide.context: Both conditions must overlap: the player character must be drunk during the bird flight inside a Hidden Mountain dream.

steps.text: Enter a Hidden Mountain dream that presents a bird-flight sequence.
Before taking flight, consume alcohol until the player character receives the game's drunken state.
Complete the bird-flight sequence while the drunken state is active.

achievements.description: Always strive to fly higher, no matter the time or place.
achievements.summary: Completing @mechanic{Sky's the Limit} currently closes the Wandering Tale but does not award its Steam achievement; start the tale from @npc{Zhou Fei} northwest of @loc{Millennium Crossing Landmark}.

guide.context: This Wandering Tale requires two separate four-day waits. Advancing time with @mechanic{Shen — Day After Tomorrow} twice completes each wait quickly.

steps.text: In Hidden Mountain's Shenze area, climb the rocky hills northwest of the @loc{Millennium Crossing Landmark} fast-travel point and speak with @npc{Zhou Fei}.
Go to Zhou Fei's right and collect the @item{Swordsman Book}.
Search the cave-like workshop northwest of the Millennium Crossing Landmark fast-travel point and collect the first @item{Trauma Poultice} from the shelter roof.
Return to Zhou Fei, give him the Trauma Poultice, and advance four in-game days.
Speak with Zhou Fei at the same location, return to the workshop, collect the second Trauma Poultice near the ladder, and give it to him.
Advance another four in-game days; Zhou Fei will leave his previous location.

Climb the stone mountain northwest of the Millennium Crossing Landmark fast-travel point, use the tale's sensing ability to follow the path, leap onto the upper stone, and collect the @item{Flight Experiment Journal}. The journal finishes the tale, but the current update does not award the Steam achievement.

achievements.description: Allow no one to sleep peacefully in your domain.
achievements.summary: No current Hidden Mountain domain interaction can unlock @mechanic{My Domain, My Rules}; a future update must add the condition that prevents anyone from sleeping peacefully.

guide.context: Four other new Hidden Mountain achievements are obtainable in the current update. The domain entry remains outside that available set.

steps.text: Wait for a content update that adds the Hidden Mountain domain activity, then complete its sleep-disruption condition.

achievements.description: Add your enemies' heads to the macabre monument.
achievements.summary: In Hidden Mountain, place defeated enemies' heads on the @mechanic{macabre skull monument}.

guide.context: The achievement connects combat spoils to a specific Hidden Mountain monument, so ordinary enemy defeats away from that monument do not complete the condition.

steps.text: Defeat enemies in Hidden Mountain and retain the enemy heads used by the macabre monument.
Bring the collected heads to the @mechanic{macabre skull monument} and add them to the display.
Continue adding enemy heads until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Enter Derndale for the first time while wearing the Infinite Truths mask.
achievements.summary: Equip the @item{Infinite Truths mask} before entering @loc{Derndale} for the first time.

guide.context: The mask must already be visibly equipped when the first-entry transition occurs; carrying it in the inventory does not express the required disguise condition.

steps.text: Obtain the @item{Infinite Truths mask} and equip it on the player character.
While the Infinite Truths mask remains equipped, cross into @loc{Derndale} for the first time.
